cases.given: canonical own-lab FAULT entry, step-only Supervisor error
cases.expected: syntactic observation; no faulty path invented

cases.given: unknown field, bool counter, foreign lab, unknown enum or version
cases.expected: refused; no partial healthy prefix

cases.given: fault/history final fragment or invalid canonical line
cases.expected: blocked; no ACK or repair

cases.given: limit exceeded in lines, bytes, depth or integer digits
cases.expected: bounded refusal; never valid prefix

cases.given: missing fault file or unreadable namespace
cases.expected: unknown/blocked; never healthy empty log

cases.given: properly provisioned existing empty fault file
cases.expected: empty observation only after source provenance

cases.given: matching policy/full-root digest and last history tuple
cases.expected: structural match; semantic trust and durability separate

cases.given: history appended, old policy remains
cases.expected: TRUST_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE; no older-prefix fallback

cases.given: equal version retry after interrupted installation
cases.expected: complete exact pending tuple; no duplicate history append

cases.given: decreasing floor, duplicate version or reordered history
cases.expected: refused

cases.given: benign metadata growth but revoked key restored in supplied roots
cases.expected: existing semantic root comparison refuses; parser never claims PASS

cases.given: external termination refers to another child/attempt/op/fault
cases.expected: refused

cases.given: external termination ledger MISSING/BUSY/CORRUPT/CONFLICT or >1 entries
cases.expected: refused; not absence

cases.given: verified same-op valid-ledger absence after OP_LOG fault
cases.expected: external terminal claim ABANDONED; faulty child stays barred

cases.given: verified same-op exact consumption after OP_LOG fault
cases.expected: external terminal claim FAILED_CONSUMED; no new acceptance

cases.given: terminated faulty child and unrelated good operation
cases.expected: skip only faulty child log; independent global faults still block

cases.given: external set-aside without D3 provenance, matching termination or BEGIN
cases.expected: refused

cases.given: external set-aside move interrupted or durability fault
cases.expected: pending or blocked; no automatic move/clear/retry

cases.given: ledger or individuals/quarantine-root fault followed by TERMINATED_EXTERNALLY
cases.expected: sticky resource restriction retained

cases.given: target path is absolute, traversing, linked, alien owner or not mapped to opened resource
cases.expected: refused before action

cases.given: operation DURABILITY_FAULT with missing/mismatched external digest
cases.expected: unknown/blocked; no invented fault record

cases.given: duplicate termination or contradictory ledger finding
cases.expected: refused; no last-write-wins

cases.given: first trust installation fails before any child exists
cases.expected: scope LAB with null birth fields; sticky trust-resource fault, no invented operation

cases.given: parent fsync fails for op-log/admission/envelope/ledger/trust creation
cases.expected: exact directory resource and DIRECTORY kind; no mislabel as file

cases.given: faulty PREPARED unreadable and no independently bound complete envelope
cases.expected: termination blocked until reviewed provenance source or operation-only inspection primitive; no caller assertion

cases.given: scope OPERATION combined with phase TRUST_INSTALL
cases.expected: refused; TRUST_INSTALL requires LAB and null birth fields

cases.given: external D3 termination but no independently bound frozen expected identity bytes
cases.expected: set-aside blocked; current partial home cannot define its own expected identity
